facts_from_this_range.statement: James Dimon signs as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer; the source is the April 6, 2026 proxy within the FY2025 reporting container, not a December 31 board snapshot.
Stephen B. Burke is Lead Independent Director.
During early 2026, Rometty became Corporate Governance and Nominating Chair; Gorsky and Buck joined that committee, Smith and Boler Davis joined Public Responsibility.
Todd Combs resigned from the Board in December 2025 to join management; a change of executive role is not treated as continued Board membership.
Eleven nominees are listed; all independent except the CEO, with proposed service until the next annual meeting if elected.
Complete nominee roster and the principal committee text columns appear in the opening summary; other-company principal occupations and heritage-company tenure remain separate.

All eleven current nominees are existing directors, one-year proposed term to 2027; twelve directors attended the 2025 meeting. These are distinct current/proposed/historical times. Combs resignation was announced December8,2025, which is not an independently stated exact resignation day.

Burke is Lead Independent Director since2021; Bammann director since2013 with Risk chair and CMDC; Buck since2025 with Audit/CGNC; Boler Davis since2023 with PRC/Risk; Gorsky since2022 with Audit/CGNC; Hobson since2018 PRC chair/Risk; Novakovic since2020 Audit/PRC. Outside-company roles are kept separate.

James Dimon current director since2004/chair since2006/CEO since2005 are attributed to JPM; BankOne chairman2000–2004 is a separate predecessor role. Source card explicitly states both his name and current JPM title, contrary to older selection omitting the adjacent name.
